integrity: Finite computations check identities and examples; all-parameter mathematical assertions rest on the included analytic proof. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact planar linear two-shear family, two letters of each in period four, \(0<a<1\) and \(k\geq0\). Neither general switched systems nor nonlinear chaos is claimed. Boundary nonhyperbolicity and historical-priority risk remain.
title: A minimal four-step reversal of stability preference for orthogonally similar damped shears
